name: ZCBRG Admin Color Labels
author: ZCBRG

sections.description:
Your WordPress admin menu doesn’t have to be plain. ZCBRG Admin Color Labels lets every user put their personal stamp on the admin sidebar — color-code menus for instant recognition, highlight the items that matter most, match your brand, or simply make the dashboard a place you enjoy working in. Choose custom background and text colors, borders, and icons for each menu and submenu item — all per user, with zero impact on your visitors or other admins.

Features

  • Per-menu colors — Set a background and foreground color for any top-level admin menu
  • Per-submenu colors — Customize individual submenu items too
  • Apply to Submenus — One click copies a menu’s colors to all its submenu items
  • Borders — Add colored outer borders and inner highlight shadows to any menu item, with per-side colors and corner radius
  • Menu icons — Replace any menu or submenu dashicon with another from a searchable picker
  • Built-in Iris color picker — WordPress’s own color wheel with hex input
  • 20-color premade palette — WordPress admin tones + soft pastels
  • Per-user settings — Each admin customizes their own experience
  • Reset all — One click restores defaults, item by item or all at once
  • No external dependencies — Just pure WordPress

Who is it for?

  • WordPress site administrators who want to personalize their admin
  • Agencies managing multiple sites who want visual distinction
  • Users with specific color preferences or accessibility needs
  • Anyone who wants their admin menus to look more organized with color cues

Support

Please, for feature requests and issues, use the plugin’s support forum. Thank you!
sections.faq:
Are my changes visible to other users?

No. Each user customizes their own colors. Changes are stored per user in WordPress user meta.

Can I reset individual items?

Yes. Each menu item that has custom colors shows a small ✕ button next to it. Click it to clear that item’s colors.

Can I reset everything?

Yes. Click the Reset All button at the top of the settings page to clear all your customizations.

Does this work with plugins that add admin menus?

Yes! The plugin reads the actual $menu and $submenu WordPress globals, so any menu item added by any plugin will appear on the settings page and can be customized.

Will this slow down my admin?

No. The plugin only outputs a small inline <style> block on admin pages. If no colors are customized, nothing is output at all.

Does this affect the frontend of my site?

No. The plugin only runs in the WordPress admin area.
